topic: Two siblings inherit their grandmother's house
text: Well, well, the old homestead finally finds new keepers. I remember the day the grandmother, may Saint Joseph bless her soul, first planted the pear tree in the corner of the yard. She said it’d bear fruit with as much love as she put into it. Now, it stands tall and hearty, just like the two of them. They look at that house, their eyes bright as the morning sun on a perfect sowing day. I can see it in their steps, the way they pace the threshold, whispering plans for the garden, the repairs, and the chamber where guests might stay. It’s a good day, a real good day. The soil, it feels different today, more promising, as if even the earth understands a new chapter’s beginning.
